title: Agent Readiness Manager-Set Agent Posture
description: E4 (fleet posture): a closed, append-only, manager-set posture for one Agent in a project -- its deployment stage and its criticality. Follows the team-requirement target-revision convention: every write creates an immutable revision guarded by expected_current_revision_id, and who set it and when are always server-derived from the authenticated human session. Criticality drives the V1-vs-V2 evaluation-system bar and the fleet interest weight (owner ruling 2026-09-24, fleet-spec-merged.md section 9.2).

DeploymentStage.description: Reuses the agent-deployment Environment vocabulary (agents/agent_deployment_schema.json definitions/Environment) instead of forking it, and never the free-form AgentSummary.status run status.

Criticality.description: Manager-set business criticality of the Agent. Owner ruling 2026-09-24: {low, medium, high}, set per agent in the fleet view.

PostureDeclarationRequest.description: Declare or replace the Agent's posture. Both members are required: a revision is a full posture snapshot, never a partial merge. declared_by and declared_at are not accepted from the client.

expected_current_revision_id.description: The revision the form was loaded from, or null when no posture has been declared yet. A mismatch is a 409 revision_conflict.

PostureDeclarer.description: The authenticated human who set the posture. Reuses the target-revision Declarer shape, narrowed to USER: API-key principals may not set posture.

AgentPosture.description: The Agent's current manager-set posture as read on the readiness portfolio item and detail response. Fail closed: any consumer MUST treat an Agent with NONE_DECLARED (or an absent agent_posture) as criticality high, the strictest evaluation-system bar, until a manager declares otherwise. deployment_stage has no default: an undeclared Agent matches no deployment_stage filter.
